turns.text: Actually, since I was running late, driving in Phoenix traffic would have been a nightmare, so I just ran and caught the light rail instead. It's usually much more predictable when I'm in a rush.

turns.text: That sounds like a fun dynamic! It's great you have that commute time to yourself to study. How is the rest of your shift looking at the clinic today?
